question: What extent of mantra recitation is prescribed and esteemed by the gods?
premises: Recitation is prescribed up to six hundred thousand
The recitation pertains to his mantra
This recitation is desired by the gods
inference: His mantra should be recited up to six hundred thousand times, as desired by the gods.
uncertainties: rasa-lakṣa is read as six lakhs by traditional numerical convention
plain_english: His mantra, desired by the gods, is to be recited up to six hundred thousand times.
